description: "The Gypsy Queen's Vow" by May Agnes Fleming is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story opens with the figure of a gipsy queen, Ketura, determinedly making her way through a stormy night toward London, driven by an overwhelming desire that hints at deep emotional turmoil and desperation.
